title: Cross-Protocol Linked Mandate
note: How one agent action carries both a payment authorization and a communication authorization while keeping them separately signed. AP2 authorizes the payment; APH authorizes the action surrounding it. All three fields are independently optional, so a vault mutation with no payment link is as legal as a payment link with no mutation.
book_ref: APH Spec: §7.1.10 LinkedMandate, §7.5 Registered optional extensions
